assets.prompt: Create one opaque original four-cell children's lesson art atlas in a precise 2×2 grid, equal square cells and a square overall image. All objects and story contents within their own quadrant, with uninterrupted warm-cream margins and gutters and no drawn grid lines. Fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper edges, warm cream, pine green, apricot and persimmon, high readability at small sizes. Top-left: a simple warm room with an intact wall and a clear window frame. On a low shelf below the window, a single four-blade colorful paper pinwheel with a visible stick is planted in a small clay pot; a visibly empty open-top box sits on the same shelf separately to its side, with a gap. No other toy. Top-right: a front-facing plain wooden doorway, slightly open door. Two long vertical outer jambs and one unbroken horizontal lintel are prominent and all entirely within the frame, dark pine green contrasted against cream walls and pale floor. A child peeks through the narrow opening behind the door, not covering the main outer frame. Bottom-left: on exactly flat pale warm cream with no other object, one long medium-blue knitted scarf positioned diagonally lower left to upper right, new ribbed knit pattern, visibly knitted with short fringe. Bottom-right: exact same long scarf design, size, angle, framing, layout, fringe, and light as bottom-left, but clear bright leaf-green color. Scarf shadows subtle and identical; no text, lettering, digits, labels, glyphs, watermark, frames, arrows or extra pictures. Keep an empty 10% margin around the outer silhouette of each image.
